title: Soldier of Fortune - host a LAN game
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
> "%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo set gl_mode "%FR_Q2MODE%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo set vid_fullscreen "1"
_note: NOT CURRENTLY STAGED - kept as the record of a REFUTED hypothesis. The image these mount was staged on 2026-08-31 and removed again the same day: a SOF-labelled retail image mounted on .143 (DAEMON Tools 3.47) and on .246 (WinCDEmu) still produced the game's own 'WON Error! Please insert the SOF CD', which is the IDENTICAL message a box with no mounter at all (.123) produces. Same failure with and without the disc, so the disc is not the gate. Do not re-stage the 795 MB image on the strength of the volume-label theory - see Games-Library/SoldierOfFortune/README-FLEET.txt. SoF 1's CD check fires only when the game goes MULTIPLAYER; single player runs with no disc at all, which is why 'Play Soldier of Fortune.bat' does NOT mount and still works on a box with no mounter.
